title: [3.0-beta1] Chart (2,...) options
body:
Reporting bugs
--------------
- **1** Next chart has only values, that are not selected in the previous graph
-  **2** Changing the language to English is not complete
![Screenshot_20211021-101228_AndroidAPS 1](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/54218454/138238437-075bcd8e-c2a3-4992-a699-ec6744e258e5.jpg)

comments.body: Same to me with the graphs. I selected „Aktivität“ (Activity) on my main and my first graph in 2.8.2. But in beta-1, it’s not shown as selectable option in the other graphs.

This is expected behavior to not show the same values on more graphs
Languages are tricky. Android doesn't provide any API to change the language for single app. Recommended is to use default language which will match to OS primary language
